items.title: Introducing Zero Wire, a hub for investigating critical Internet vulnerabilities

sentences.en: Introducing Zero Wire, a hub for investigating critical Internet vulnerabilities.
sentences.zh: Zero Wire是调查关键互联网漏洞的枢纽。

sentences.en: You run security at your organization.
sentences.zh: 您在您的组织中运行安全。

sentences.en: It’s 7:00 am, and you’re having breakfast.
sentences.zh: 现在是早上7点，您正在吃早餐。

sentences.en: You receive a ping: a new critical vulnerability has been disclosed.
sentences.zh: 您收到一个ping ：一个新的严重漏洞已被披露。

sentences.en: Your team scrambles to compare vendor advisories, read technical research, check which systems run the affected software, and answer familiar questions from the business: are we affected, and what are we doing about it?
sentences.zh: 您的团队争先恐后地比较供应商建议，阅读技术研究，检查哪些系统运行受影响的软件，并回答业务部门熟悉的问题：我们是否受到影响，我们正在对此采取什么措施？

sentences.en: Another disclosure arrives before that work is finished.
sentences.zh: 另一项披露是在工作完成之前到达的。

sentences.en: AI is changing both the volume and speed of critical vulnerability discovery.
sentences.zh: 人工智能正在改变关键漏洞发现的数量和速度。

sentences.en: It can analyze large codebases at scale and surface deeply nested flaws that may have existed for years without being found through human review.
sentences.zh: 它可以分析大规模的大型代码库，并揭示可能已经存在多年的深度嵌套漏洞，而无需通过人工审查。

sentences.en: That discovery momentum will put more pressure on security teams to understand the impact of each disclosure on their infrastructure.
sentences.zh: 这种发现势头将给安全团队带来更大的压力，要求他们了解每次披露对其基础设施的影响。

sentences.en: To help security teams prepare, today we’re introducing Zero Wire : a public vulnerability intelligence feed on Cloudflare Radar, bringing the clarity of a news wire service to critical security developments.
sentences.zh: 为了帮助安全团队做好准备，我们今天推出了Zero Wire ： Cloudflare Radar上的公共漏洞情报源，将新闻通讯服务的清晰度带入关键的安全开发中。

sentences.en: It helps security leaders and practitioners understand significant vulnerabilities and decide what to do next.
sentences.zh: 它有助于安全领导者和从业人员了解重大漏洞，并决定下一步该怎么做。

sentences.en: How it works Zero Wire lives inside Cloudflare Radar under the security section.
sentences.zh: Zero Wire的工作原理位于Cloudflare Radar的安全部分。

sentences.zh: 据报道，美国中期选举前夕的罢工目标是针对美国资产的地对空导弹。美国周一晚些时候对伊朗的格什姆岛发动了有限的罢工，此前几小时，副总统万斯表示，他对结束战争的外交努力朝着正确的方向前进持乐观态度。

sentences.zh: 伊朗人在社交媒体上披露并得到美国中央司令部（ Centcom ）确认的罢工发生在关键的中期选举前夕，预计唐纳德特朗普的共和党将受到选民的惩罚。

items.title: Fossilised red blood cells found in 115m-year-old dinosaur’s bone, say scientists

sentences.en: Fossilised red blood cells found in 115m-year-old dinosaur’s bone, say scientists.
sentences.zh: 科学家说，在1.15亿年前的恐龙骨骼中发现了化石红细胞。

sentences.en: Chemical tests on Aratasaurus bone identify presence of heme, the organic compound that allows haemoglobin in blood to carry oxygen around body It could be the opening of a Jurassic Park rip-off: scientists examining ancient dinosaur bones find what appear to be fossilised red blood cells, and traces of the molecule that gives the beast’s blood its distinctive crimson hue.
sentences.zh: 对Aratasaurus骨骼的化学测试确定了血红素的存在，血红素是一种允许血液中的血红蛋白在身体周围携带氧气的有机化合物。这可能是侏罗纪公园撕裂的开始：科学家检查古代恐龙骨骼，发现似乎是化石红细胞，以及使野兽血液具有独特深红色调的分子痕迹。

sentences.en: But that is what researchers are claiming to have discovered after analysing the hind leg bones of a small, meat-eating dinosaur called an Aratasaurus that lived and died in what is now north-eastern Brazil 115m years ago.
sentences.zh: 但这正是研究人员声称在分析了1.15亿年前在巴西东北部生活和死亡的一种名为Aratasaurus的小型肉食恐龙的后腿骨后发现的。

items.title: AWS Weekly Roundup: GPT-6.1 Terra on Bedrock, Step Functions as agent tools, and more (November 2, 2026)

sentences.en: AWS Weekly Roundup: GPT-6.1 Terra on Bedrock, Step Functions as agent tools, and more (November 2, 2026).
sentences.zh: AWS每周综述： GPT-6.1基岩上的Terra、作为代理工具的步骤函数等（ 2026年11月2日）。

sentences.en: The agentic launches that stayed with me last week had nothing to do with how capable a model is.
sentences.zh: 上周留在我身边的代理发布与模特的能力无关。

sentences.en: They were about reach.
sentences.zh: 他们差不多到达了。

sentences.en: AWS Step Functions , which already orchestrates over 220 AWS services, can now be handed to an agent as a tool, so workflows teams already trust became callable without a rewrite.
sentences.zh: AWS Step Functions已经协调了220多项AWS服务，现在可以作为工具交给代理，因此工作流程团队已经信任，无需重写即可调用。

sentences.en: In the same week, the AI blog published how one engagement platform exposed roughly 400 internal API operations the same way.
sentences.zh: 在同一周，人工智能博客发表了一个参与平台如何以同样的方式暴露了大约400个内部API操作。

sentences.en: Neither story involves rebuilding anything, only describing what exists and letting the agent find it.
sentences.zh: 这两个故事都不涉及重建任何东西，只涉及描述存在的东西并让客服代表找到它。

sentences.en: The other thread was cost.
sentences.zh: 另一个线程是成本。

sentences.en: OpenAI’s newest Terra model reached Amazon Bedrock priced well below the model beside it, and two post-quantum launches landed for a deadline nobody can put on a calendar yet.
sentences.zh: OpenAI最新的Terra型号到达了亚马逊基岩，其价格远低于旁边的型号，并且两次后量子发布的截止日期还没有人可以放在日历上。

sentences.en: Now, let’s get into this week’s AWS news… Headlines OpenAI GPT-6.1 Terra is now generally available on Amazon Bedrock , and what interests me is where it sits rather than what it tops.
sentences.zh: 现在，让我们来看看本周的AWS新闻… Headlines OpenAI GPT-6.1 Terra现已在Amazon Bedrock上正式推出，我感兴趣的是它的位置，而不是它的顶部。

sentences.en: Terra is the everyday-workload line of the GPT-6 family.
sentences.zh: TERRA是GPT-6系列的日常工作负载系列。

sentences.en: In OpenAI’s Agents’ Last Exam evaluation it scored 15 percentage points higher than GPT-5.6 Terra, performed on par with GPT-6 Astra, and completed tasks more than three times faster than both.
sentences.zh: 在OpenAI的代理人期末考试评估中，它比GPT-5.6 TERRA高出15个百分点，与GPT-6 ASTRA的表现相当，完成任务的速度比两者都快三倍以上。

sentences.en: Those are OpenAI’s figures, not an independent test.
sentences.zh: 这些是OpenAI的数据，不是独立测试。
